quote.text: Not everything that can be counted counts, and not everything that counts can be counted.
quote.author: William Bruce Cameron, Informal Sociology, 1963

stories.headline: Bernina moved its last Swiss assembly line to Thailand in May 2026
stories.dek: Twenty-seven Steckborn jobs went on 18 February, and the B 990 now ships from Lamphun. bernina.com.sg still sells “Swiss tradition and perfection since 1893”.

stories.headline: The Nepenthes pitcher kills with a rim that works only when wet
stories.dek: On a wet peristome, weaver ants fell into the pitcher on 21 of 21 visits. On a dry one, none fell in 18. Three species grow wild in Singapore.

stories.headline: Singapore Airlines starts Madrid on 26 October and drops the Milan–Barcelona tag
stories.dek: SQ388 leaves at 2330 five times weekly on an A350-900; the three-weekly SIN–Milan–Barcelona service ends the next day.

stories.headline: Iran’s Guards declare Hormuz closed; CENTCOM says the strait is American-controlled
stories.dek: Twelve ships were attacked in the week to 16 October — and the centre that counts them says the true figure is higher than it can report. Brent settled at $109.86.

stories.headline: Singapore’s NEA says its 2015 haze investigations are still open
stories.dek: Grace Fu issued seven preventive notices on 16 October and conceded the law “may not be so effective”. The agency forecasts 150–220 PSI for Sunday.

stories.headline: China lists 23 AI technologies for export control, exempting open-source releases
stories.dek: MOFCOM and the science ministry opened comment to 15 November — and a pre-export registration duty took effect immediately, on 16 October, catching shipments already begun.

stories.headline: Amazon launches the Bee Frontier at US$74.99, a wristband that listens all day
stories.dek: Announced 15 October, US-only at launch, with a US$11.99 monthly tier. A former AWS security engineer says the consent prompt reaches the wrong person.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Patek In Milan
stories.headline: Patek Philippe’s Milan Aquanaut costs US$43,761 and sells only in Italy
stories.dek: Two hundred and fifty pieces of Ref. 5167A-014, made for the Watch Art Grand Exhibition that closes in Milan today, 18 October.

stories.headline: Fontaines D.C. release Dopamine Chamber to a Metascore of 85
stories.dek: Out 16 October with a guest turn from ROSALÍA. No. 135 called it a film and gave it 84; both are corrected below.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Phone Trial
stories.headline: Science publishes a 16,683-student phone ban that moved grades 0.073 SD
stories.dek: Published in Science on 8 October, the trial ran in ten Indian colleges. Its youngest subject is an undergraduate; not one participant is twelve.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · A Bull Flattening
stories.headline: US CPI rose 0.6 per cent in September; the 10-year fell 15 basis points
stories.dek: Gasoline is up 34.2 per cent on the year, yet the long end rallied: an AI credit scare beat an energy inflation shock to the bond market.

stories.headline: A Maturitas review of 284 trials ranks swimming first for systolic pressure
stories.dek: Published 16 October, pooling 18,750 adults at a mean age of 56.8. Swimming took 10.28 mmHg off systolic; mind–body work led on diastolic.

stories.headline: Singapore Writers Festival’s early-bird pass reverts from S$24 to S$30 today
stories.dek: Tokyo’s Shojo Manga Infinity opens 28 October, with advance tickets at ¥2,000 until the 27th; Clockenflap’s Amex discount runs to 10 November.

stories.headline: Rojali is the Indonesian word for a mall crowd that never buys
stories.dek: Bank Indonesia says real retail sales grew 1.3 per cent in August. The statistics bureau says household consumption grew 5.06. Both figures are official.
